title: Ingest ABC, MusicXML, MIDI and LilyPond with the licence-evidence gate
context: Common Studio is an open, public-domain music production studio in software, written new in Python with permissive dependencies and released under the Unlicense. This task is part of its first milestones: the licence-clean spine that every later gate depends on. The owner's private reference pipeline may be consulted for ideas only; no text, configuration value, arrangement source, skill or asset from it may be copied, and every name, format and value is authored new.
objective: Implement ingest for ABC, MusicXML, MIDI and LilyPond into the core model, refusing any work whose evidence record is incomplete, applying the sourcing policy's source classes, and writing the evidence to work.yaml, as Python under src/.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-03: ABC, MusicXML, MIDI and LilyPond fixtures each parse into Work, Arrangement and Part on the beat grid, with one fixture and one passing test per format.

AC-04: A work whose evidence record lacks composition, edition or lyrics (lyrics may be none), each needing source, basis, checked_at and checker, is refused and the refusal names the missing record, with a test per missing record; a complete record writes work.yaml with the evidence.
AC-05: A banned source is refused even for a public-domain tune and a verify-only source is flagged, as the sourcing policy says, with tests for each.
AC-06: Each parser survives fuzzed malformed input without crashing the process, with a fuzz test per parser.
No copyleft dependency enters the package tree and the licence audit passes in CI.
Tests pass; the commit is DCO signed-off.
output: A pull request adding the ingest module, the evidence gate, fixtures for all four formats, fuzz tests and the sourcing-policy check under src/.
